_help: The bots. Each body is one of the cars in web/cars (model: its id there; tools/cars/ makes them). 'robot' is what it becomes: its height in metres, how broad (bulk), its head, and how many seconds it takes to change (shift). 'stats' compare the bodies, 1 = middling: speed (as a car), armour, power (punches and guns), agility (as a robot). Weapons and specials are chosen separately.

bodies.name: Goblin
bodies.about: A low, angry hypercar. The fastest thing on wheels, and a lean, sharp robot.

bodies.name: Cheetah
bodies.about: A wedge-shaped supercar of the old school, wing and all.

bodies.name: Abyss
bodies.about: A track hypercar with its bodywork cut to the bone. Changes in a blink.

bodies.name: Stinger
bodies.about: A mid-engined supercar, smooth and quick in every way.

bodies.name: Sovereign
bodies.about: A long-nosed grand tourer: fast, comfortable, and well built.

bodies.name: Nomad
bodies.about: A classic mid-engined sports car with pop-up lamps.

bodies.name: Kiri
bodies.about: A widebody tuner with a big wing. Hits harder than it looks.

bodies.name: Vanguard
bodies.about: A muscle car with stripes. Hits like a hammer, turns like one too.

bodies.name: Thunderbolt
bodies.about: A rally sedan: grips anywhere, and quick on its feet as a robot.

bodies.name: Meridian
bodies.about: A sporty modern saloon. Good at everything, best at nothing.

bodies.name: Halcyon
bodies.about: A sleek sportback. Balanced, with a long reach as a robot.

bodies.name: Summit
bodies.about: A big luxury SUV. Heavy armour, a tall robot with a long reach.

bodies.name: Wyvern
bodies.about: An armoured off-road concept. Built to take a beating.

bodies.name: Ridgeback
bodies.about: A lifted pickup with a bull bar. Slow to change, the toughest thing on the field.

weapons.name: Blaster
weapons.about: Rapid bolts. Good at any range.

weapons.name: Cannon
weapons.about: Slow, heavy shells that blow up where they land.

weapons.name: Scatter
weapons.about: A wide spray up close. Devastating, short-ranged.

specials.name: Shield
specials.about: A dome that stops shots for a few seconds. Friends can shelter in it.

specials.name: Shockwave
specials.about: Slam the ground: everything close is thrown back and stunned.

specials.name: Missiles
specials.about: A salvo of homing missiles at the nearest enemies.
